# Centrifugo (`centrifugal-centrifugo`)

Boost your app's real-time capabilities with Centrifugo, an open-source messaging server supporting WebSocket, HTTP-streaming, and more. Scale effortlessly, integrate with any backend, and enhance user engagement today!

[Source](https://github.com/centrifugal/centrifugo)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "centrifugal-centrifugo"
  name       = "mycentrifugo"

  parameters = {
    # ApiKey         = "..."
    # RedisUrl       = "..."
    # AllowedOrigins = "..."
  }

  sensitive_parameters = {
    TokenHmacSecretKey = var.token_hmac_secret_key
    AdminPassword = var.admin_password
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TokenHmacSecretKey` | string | yes | Secret key used for HMAC signing of JWT tokens for connection authentication Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |
| `AdminPassword` | string | yes | Password required to access Centrifugo's embedded admin web UI Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |
| `ApiKey` | string | no | Authentication key for accessing Centrifugo's HTTP and GRPC server API |
| `RedisUrl` | string | no | Connection URL for Redis server used for built-in scalability and message brokering |
| `AllowedOrigins` | string | no |  |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
